name: Burger King
source_title: Burger King UK menu: each product's 'Nutritional Information & Allergens' panel (read 2026-10-10, no date shown)
sites_evidence: No restaurant count was read: the menu pages show 'Select restaurant for pricing' and item availability by restaurant. Needs a count (the store locator at https://www.burgerking.co.uk/store-locator was not opened).
note: Per-item panels printed by the chain; fibre is not printed. Several items print 0.7 g sugars (looks like a placeholder; copied as printed). Items sold in several sizes (fries, drinks) appear for the sizes whose panel was read. Drinks, dips, sauces and most desserts were not read. Menu availability varies by restaurant.
